results.title: Moving Forwards
results.overview: Six friends. One normal summer night. A future that suddenly disappears. As the months begin to move on, the friends left behind each find their own way of carrying the absence of who they lost. When they reunite, old memories resurface, reminding them that moving forwards doesn't always mean leaving the past behind.

results.title: The Ship of Theseus
results.overview: Medical imagery, retrieved from the filmmaker’s body when he had a bone marrow transplant in 2021, becomes the foundation for disembodied questions of selfhood. In this experimental documentary, 2D and 3D animations create an abstract series of landscapes out of scans originally taken for medical treatment.

results.title: Theme Song
results.overview: Singers perform in their homes to faceless internet crowds. They sing about their desire for control.

results.title: Age Perfect
results.overview: A video essay that playfully uses performance-based methods of re-enactment to attempt to enter the frame and material conditions of anti-aging cream commercials and other beauty ads to critique their construction while showcasing their artifice.

results.title: A New Kind of Daytime
results.overview: A New Kind of Daytime is an absurd sci-fi that imagines a future where “care” is monetized by budget AI. A satirical monologue is riddled with a fever-dream of images and events that could be the memories of a dementing mind, or the glitches of a device-controlled brain.

results.title: Beach Day
results.overview: Fish, bodybuilders and soccer games re-materialize in a boy’s mind. Inspired by childhood videos and transitioning, Beach Day is a collage of past and present, digital and analog, imagined and real. Digitized camcorder video, rotoscoped animations and narrated anecdotes merge with ambient noises to create an unravelling of time.

results.title: The Quest for Emerald Mountain
results.overview: Set against the arid mountains and wide skies of West Texas, two best friends chase the perfect photo for a model train and in doing so, create an unexpected portrait of intimacy, creativity, and tenderness in male friendship.

results.title: The Evaluation
results.overview: A psychiatrist evaluates a prisoner who claims he is possessed by an ancient evil. When the entity exposes the doctor's deepest weakness, the line between doctor and patient begins to disappear.

results.title: 29-O Dana
results.overview: 29-O Dana reconstructs the decisive hours of the floods that struck Valencia province on 29 October 2024, tracing the warnings that arrived and the choices made as the emergency unfolded. Alongside relatives of those who died, the film confronts the political response—and the questions the disaster leaves unresolved.

results.title: Doggy-Dog World
results.overview: On the night of his band’s big come-back, a sober musician has a panic attack and locks himself in the green room with a bottle of schnapps. It’s up to his long-suffering best friend to get him through it and get him on stage.

results.title: Preparing Innineu: Partridge Cleaning in Sheshatshiu
results.original_title: Preparing Innineu: Partridge Cleaning in Sheshatshiu
results.overview: Partridges are a common food source for Innu First Nation People in Labrador, especially in Sheshatshiu. Partridge is Innineu in Innu-aimun. This film captures a cultural workshop at the Manishan Nui Gull Island Gathering, filmed by Innu youth Reighlyn Penashue and Karlianna Pokue, with help from emerging filmmakers Heidi Atter and Charlie Pye-Strowbridge.

results.title: The Fixation
results.overview: Álvaro, an accomplished photographer struggling with debt and his father’s terminal illness, reluctantly accepts an erotic photography assignment designed to recruit VIP clients. But the project takes an unexpected turn when he discovers that its star is Felipe, a famous model with whom he shares a turbulent past. Their reunion reignites a toxic relationship fueled by desire, jealousy, and obsession. As tensions escalate and increasingly dangerous situations surround the project, Álvaro must navigate the blurred lines between passion and madness while fighting to maintain his sanity—and survive.

results.title: AAA Héroes Inmortales 2026 - Week 1
results.overview: Héroes Inmortales 2026 is a professional wrestling event produced by Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide. It takes place on October 24, 2026, at Gimnasio Olímpico Juan de la Barrera in Mexico City, Mexico.

results.title: Marguerite
results.overview: Inspired by a true story, Marguerite recounts the fate of Marguerite de la Rocque, a sixteenth-century noblewoman marooned on an island off Newfoundland, who survives the loss of everything she loves.

results.title: A Family
results.overview: A child actor wandering between reality and fiction, a prisoner using his furlough, and a woman trapped at her son’s christening. A day in the life of each of the three members of a family over whom the same question hangs: Who am I, and who do I want to be? Three stories about identity, separated by time, but united by blood ties and a decision that will mark the lives of all three.

results.title: Mary
results.overview: A woman has a spirit haunting her upon leaving her church.

results.title: Forgotten Holiday
results.overview: Kathryn Liu is an antiques buyer for her father’s store and has been happily dating Rob Ashford for nearly a year. When he surprises her with a pre-Christmas proposal, her fear of a failed relationship sends her dashing away without giving him an answer. Heartbroken, as Rob drives to his sister’s house he has a car accident that leaves him without memories of the past year, including their relationship and his once-infectious love of Christmas. Following the unconventional orders from his doctor, Kathryn agrees to help trigger Rob’s memory by retracing their romance and reintroducing him to the holidays. But as his memories inch closer to returning, Kathryn must face the painful truth that bringing Rob back to himself may mean losing him forever, unless she can finally find the courage to fight for the love she was too afraid to claim.

results.title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in Buenos Aires
results.original_title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in Buenos Aires
results.overview: This cinema presentation brings BTS’s Buenos Aires concert to the big screen, marking the group’s first performance in Argentina and its first live viewing broadcast from South America. Audiences can experience the explosive atmosphere of a packed stadium in a 195-minute event, with some territories receiving a time-shifted screening.

results.title: Togel: Diantara PHK dan Hutang
results.overview: After losing his job, Agus pretends to leave for work every morning to spare his pregnant wife the truth. Instead, he roams the streets looking for work and borrowing money just to survive. When Rijal, an old friend with a gambling habit and a talent for bad decisions, reappears, Agus tries his luck with a lottery "magic book" that promises winning numbers. Instead of getting rich, he is chased by debt collectors and forced to hide from his wife's family. Things get stranger when he meets Om Jhon, a quirky ghost who claims to know the secret to lucky numbers. Desperate for one number to change his life, Agus is pulled into a chaotic, darkly funny adventure.
